<!-- pr-reviewer: e27c985598870c271d87c94a03c2edc864622ccf -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Every post path runs the gate: `post_script_body` (GUI/CLI `post_setup`/`post_script`, posting.rs:325), `post_per_op_script` (posting_per_op.rs:88) and the script API gate (script/api.rs:141) all call `verification_report`, which now includes `rotated_wcs_problems` (posting.rs:506).
- Same slot, same ops: `wcs_context` (posting.rs:768) and the clause both call `wcs_rotation::wcs_slot`; the clause walks `operation_order` minus suppressed ops, exactly `program_ops`. Same `op.setup` + `wcs_entity` lookup, so no posted op uses an offset the check did not judge.
- Rotation about any axis is caught: the test is on the angle `2*atan2(|xyz|,|w|)`, not the Z component (the setup test pins X; 180 deg gives w=0 and is refused). A NaN `w` fails `angle <= tol` and is refused too.
- 1e-9 rad is nanometre-scale at 1 m, so no meaningful rotation passes; identity with 1e-13 noise posts byte-identical (pinned, plus undo).
- No golden changed, no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in src (only `unwrap_or*`), provenance line present, decision file present, body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #315`, no CHANGELOG.md edit.

**Local results (trial-merged with current origin/main, merged cleanly; debug)**
| suite | result |
|---|---|
| posting | 17 ok |
| conformance | 6 ok |
| fanuc_post | 8 ok |
| golden_cl | 23 ok |
| per_op_files | 9 ok |
| post_not_judged | 4 ok |
| setups | 11 ok |
| wcs_align | 5 ok |
| probe_op | 11 ok |
| tormach_post | 10 ok |
| lathe_post | 7 ok |
| scripting | 17 ok |
| machine | 32 ok |
| rotated_wcs | 4 ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `angle_axis` (posting_wcs_rotation.rs:50) returns "unrotated" for a non-finite xyz part (NaN quaternion). I did not check whether `SetWcsOrigin` already refuses non-finite rotations; if it does not, treating non-finite as rotated (refuse) would be the safer direction.
2. The setup sheet (`setup_sheet/sections.rs:63`) lists only the offset translation, so a rotated offset is invisible there. It is documentation, not NC output, but a rotation line would help once step 3 of #315 lands.
3. posting.rs stays at 1036 lines (down 3); already over the 400-line target, no growth.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
